title: Heartbeat and liveness
summary: Working means an in-flight tool or a recent running/unknown turn. Finished turns and other non-ended sessions are Waiting; end stamps make Ended. Active time takes the latest tool, heartbeat, prompt/stop or recorded turn-end stamp. The project idle window defaults to 20 minutes. CLI, Sessions, Frontier and Machines share the server status; card details retain raw state. Reclaim, fleet reports and message liveness keep their separate rules.
